title: Fan Family Sorter
description: A p5.js sorting activity in which learners place fifteen current Twin City Fan product lines into the centrifugal, axial and mixed flow families from short descriptions that never name the family. Each placement locks and shows the correct family and the reason; a summary lists every miss and reports mastery at 13 of 15.

educational.audience: New application engineers, sales staff, manufacturer's representatives, distributors and plant staff
educational.topic: Fan families: centrifugal, axial and mixed flow
learningObjectives: The learner will differentiate fifteen Twin City Fan product lines into the centrifugal, axial and mixed flow families from a short description of each, correctly placing at least 13 of 15 on the first placement.
prerequisites: unhoused centrifugal fan (plenum and plug types)

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); verdicts, new cards and the summary announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; keys 1, 2, 3 place a card and Enter or N turns up the next; every button is reachable with Tab and pressed with Enter or Space; buttons wrap to a second row at 320 px.

controls.label: Centrifugal
controls.purpose: Place the face-up card in the Centrifugal bin (key 1)

controls.label: Axial
controls.purpose: Place the face-up card in the Axial bin (key 2)

controls.label: Mixed flow
controls.purpose: Place the face-up card in the Mixed flow bin (key 3)

controls.label: Next card / Show summary
controls.purpose: Turn up the next card after reading the feedback; after the fifteenth card, show the summary (Enter)

controls.label: More misses
controls.purpose: Page through the misplaced cards on the summary when they do not fit on one page

controls.label: Sort again
controls.purpose: On the summary, reshuffle all fifteen cards and reset the score

rules: The 15 cards are presented in a shuffled order (FP.CardDeck, one attempt, no practice round).
Each card can be placed once; after placement it is locked and marked correct or incorrect.
A placement is correct when it matches the card's correct bin from the chapter specification.
The score counts first placements only and is shown as 'Correct: n of 15'.
Mastery is 13 of 15; the summary reads 'Mastery reached.' or 'Review the sections on tubular housings and power roof ventilators, then sort again.'
After all 15 cards are placed, 'Sort again' reshuffles all cards and resets the score.
assumptions: Card text never contains the words centrifugal, axial, mixed flow or mixed-flow; those words appear only in the feedback.
limitations: Fifteen fixed product lines; the sorter does not cover every Twin City Fan product line named in the chapter.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Committed-placement sorting with immediate per-item feedback and an end-of-sort error review
keyQuestions: What does the description say about the path air takes through the impeller?
Which clue on this card is about the housing, the mounting location or the application rather than the impeller?
Why can two fans in the same round tube belong to different families?
commonMisconceptions: Any fan in a tubular housing is axial.
Any roof fan, or any power roof ventilator, is centrifugal.
Lab exhaust fans are their own family rather than centrifugal or mixed flow fans.
Fans without a housing cannot be centrifugal.
assessmentOpportunities: First-placement score shown as 'Correct: n of 15'; mastery is 13 of 15 on the first placement.
Summary list of misplaced cards, each with its correct family and reason, for the learner to name the clue that misled them.
